parameters.name: Category
parameters.description: The category of the Alibaba Cloud service. For example, ApsaraDB for Redis has `kvstore_standard` (Standard Edition), `kvstore_sharding` (Cluster Edition), and `kvstore_splitrw` (read/write splitting Edition).

parameters.name: Ids
parameters.description: The IDs of the alert blacklist policies.

parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description:
The instance ID list in the alert blacklist policy.

Valid values of N: 0 to 10.

parameters.name: IsEnable
parameters.description:
The status of the alert blacklist policy. Valid values:

- true: Enabled.
- false: Disabled.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description:
The name of the alert blacklist policy.

This parameter supports fuzzy match.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description:
The namespace of the Alibaba Cloud service.

For information about the namespaces of Alibaba Cloud services, see [Cloud service metrics](~~163515~~).

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The order in which the query results are sorted by time. Valid values:

0: ascending order (ASC).

1: descending order (DESC). This is the default value.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: ScopeType
parameters.description:
The effective scope of the alert blacklist policy. Valid values:

- USER: The alert blacklist policy takes effect only within the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- GROUP: The alert blacklist policy takes effect in the specified application groups.
